subject: The wardroom of the colony ship ariadne at supper, one table and one pot. Lucas and Jeremy served on the same hull before the Ariadne, and Jeremy has decided the table should hear how it started. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.

notes: A crew photo for one pairing of this card's two leads.
